Two real defects found and both are its own: (A) libical's check_contract_restriction takes a period-length parameter and resolves negative BY values with it; ical.js's port dropped the parameter, so a negative value in a CONTRACTING BY part never matches -- silently wrong answers when another value ends the search, and an unbounded allocation that ABORTS the node process when none does (FREQ=DAILY;BYMONTHDAY=-1 is enough). ical.js already has a bail-out counter in the MONTHLY and YEARLY branches and none in the five sub-monthly ones, which are exactly where BYMONTHDAY contracts. All 72 such corpus cases wrong. (B) BYHOUR/BYMINUTE/BYSECOND iterated in written order; 61/65 unsorted-time cases fail vs 112/115 sorted passing. Published as finding 070.
